subject.title: 0.42.0版本依旧还是每次刷新都会提示需要授权

question: Should this issue close now because current main contains commit 1dc05e6d7bda68664789b27ae84780f9bfe97f92, or remain open until that fix ships in a tagged release?
rationale: The technical fix is established, but the repository profile requires conservative maintainer-controlled closure and the reporter is still affected on the latest release, v0.42.0.

options.title: Wait for containing release
options.body: Keep the issue open until a tagged release includes the fix, then close it with the exact version.

options.title: Close as fixed on main
options.body: Close now while clearly noting that v0.42.0 predates the fix and users must wait for a later release.

recommendation.title: Wait for containing release
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a tagged release includes the fix, then close it with the exact version.
